header: The copy deck contains the safety-critical strings; changing them later is a product decision requiring design and security review, not a copy tweak

rules.sim.ca1.string: Simulation replays recorded market data. Fills are modelled, not real; results are not a guarantee.

rules.sim.ca2.string: What this rule would have done on recorded BTCUSDT data, 1–14 Sep: when it fired and what it did. This shows its behaviour, not its profit.

rules.sim.ca3.string: Tested on 13 of 14 days. Not tested: {7 Sep, 00:00–24:00 UTC} — no recorded data ({recording was interrupted}).

rules.sim.ca6.sentence.string: No recorded history for {ETHUSDT}, so this rule cannot be tested on it.

rules.sim.ca7.string: Modelled P&L change (USDT) — fills modelled, not a forecast

rules.arm.ca8.string: If the backend stops, this rule stops. Native stops stay.

rules.arm.ca9.string: The backend is CandleViewer's server: this rule runs there, not in this window, so closing the app does not stop it.

rules.arm.ca10.string: While the server is down or has lost Bybit, the rule moves no stops and closes nothing; your stop-loss at Bybit stays at its last price. If the server loses Bybit for over {30 s}, each account's dead man's switch also runs its policy ({Main: notify only}). The rule starts again by itself once positions are checked with Bybit, without replaying what it missed.

rules.arm.ca11.note.string: Rule engine running on CandleViewer's server since {14:02}.

rules.arm.ca11.phase_1.string: If that computer sleeps or restarts, armed rules stop until it is back.

rules.arm.ca12.yes.string: Acts on an estimate? Yes — {iceberg at level} (estimated): CandleViewer infers it from trades and the order book; Bybit does not report it. It can be wrong either way. [How it is estimated]

rules.arm.ca13.string: Can it place orders? Yes — on {Main, sub_001}, DEMO

rules.arm.ca15.string: Evidence for this version: simulated on recorded data {1–14 Sep} ({13 of 14 days}), {48} fires, {0} errors; simulating live since {08:00}, {6} fires.

rules.arm.ca16.string: You can't arm this version yet. The server requires: a completed simulation on recorded data — done; 5 simulated fires or 24 hours — {3 of 5}, or at {09:12 tomorrow}; no open safety warnings — done.

rules.arm.ca17.string: Next, confirm with your password, a 2FA code and the word LIVE. Nothing is armed until you do.

rules.arm.ca18.pending.string: Arming… waiting for the server to confirm.

rules.arm.ca21.string: 2 rules can move the same stop: {BE after 1R}, {ATR trail 2x}. [Choose which goes first]

rules.arm.ca26.string: Every position keeps its own stop-loss at Bybit, whatever this rule does. A rule can move that stop but never remove it; everything else it does needs CandleViewer's server running.

rules.arm.ca31.string: Disarm {ATR trail 2x}? It stops acting now. Stops it already moved stay at Bybit.

rules.arm.ca36.yes.string: Asks before acting? Yes — you confirm each fire within 60 s; unconfirmed fires are skipped and logged
